pages.text: A $(item)Phone PABX$() is a small exchange: $(l:radiocraft:microwave/telephone)telephones$(/l) touching it or on its $(l:radiocraft:radios/data_wire)data wire$(/l) can call each other, with no microwave radio. It needs power from the power wire; its lamp is green while it has it.$(br2)Each phone it picks up gets the lowest free $(thing)extension$() from 100. You can still change one with EXT.

pages.title: With a microwave radio
pages.text: A microwave radio is its own PABX. A phone a powered radio serves calls through the radio, out over its links, and a PABX on the same wire is not needed.
